verdict.rationale: Bento's Workflows and Sequences provide event/time-delay based automations (bento-docs-43, bento-docs-46), and its CLI/MCP surfaces let an AI agent create broadcasts, sequences, and workflows via natural language or commands (bento-docs-49, bento-docs-5/17, bento-docs-16). However, these are trigger/delay-based automations rather than explicit cron-like recurring scheduled jobs, and only broadcasts show explicit 'schedule' semantics (bento-docs-34) which are one-time sends, not recurring. missing for 10: a documented recurring/cron-style job scheduler, explicit API/CLI support for setting recurring intervals, and independent confirmation that AI agents can set up such recurring schedules end-to-end.
